text:
lina: hey everyone — first day here. followed the onboarding guide but can't reach https://console.internal.redwood from the VPN. curl times out with `connect to 10.42.3.8:443: no route to host`. macbook m2 on home wifi. any ideas?

it-support: welcome! did you pick the 'redwood-wireguard' profile or 'redwood-split'?

lina: i used 'redwood-split' since the portal recommended split tunneling for faster browsing.

samir: note that split tunnel can leave internal DNS without route. can you run `dig +short console.internal.redwood @10.42.0.2` and `scutil --dns`?

lina: dig returns 10.42.3.8 but ping/traceroute fail — traceroute hops to my ISP then drops.

kyla: @samir can you eyeball the VPC peering and route tables? last week we had a peering route missing for certain source ranges.

samir: good call. also try ssh to the bastion: `ssh lina@bastion.redwood` — that'll tell us if the jump host path is healthy.

lina: ssh prompts for MFA but then hangs at "opening remote connection" and eventually times out (~2m).

ops-bot: Auto-ticket created: NETWORK-4572 — Investigating NAT/gateway rules for peering (assigned: samir).

samir: I just tried from the jump and can reach the console internally, so the service is fine. looks like your VPN-assigned IP isn't allowed through the peering NAT/ACL. @neteng any blocking rules for public-vpn ranges?

alex: neteng here — we tightened egress on the peered VPCs last week. new hires normally get a reserved egress block when they onboard. Lina, what's your VPN IP? on mac try `ipconfig getifaddr utun1` or check `wg show`.

lina: `ipconfig getifaddr utun1` -> 100.101.12.34

alex: thanks — that's outside our allowed ranges. i've added a temporary rule to permit 100.101.12.0/24 for onboarding. give it ~90s to propagate.

lina: retrying now... curl to console works! 🎉 can load login page. still seeing ssh to bastion hang though.

samir: bastion uses a jump gateway & additional port proxying; try connecting with jump proxy: `ssh -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -J jump@bastion.redwood lina@internal-host` — that forces the proxy handshake.

lina: that `-J` jump worked immediately, thanks. what's the long-term step for normal bastion ssh to work?

alex: i'll add your IP to the onboarding whitelist for 24h. neteng will add your workstation to the corporate VPN pool once people-ops confirms HR. meanwhile add `ServerAliveInterval 30` for the host in your `~/.ssh/config` to avoid hangs. also open a ticket to security for the permanent ACL change.

lina: got it — thanks all. tagging @people-ops to confirm HR status. :)

people-ops: hi! confirmed offer accepted and equipment enrollment is in flight today. we'll notify infra once the laptop is enrolled.

samir: updating NETWORK-4572: temporary allow applied, monitoring for 10m. ping here if anything else breaks.

lina: everything working from my side now — marking this solved. :thumbsup:
